title: India Face Pakistan in U19 Asia Cup Final, Chasing a Record Ninth Title
excerpt: Raichandani's India meet unbeaten defending champions Pakistan in Al Amerat on Saturday at 10:30 a.m. IST — 9 p.m. Friday on the US West Coast — after Pakistan won their group meeting by three wickets.
body:
• The ACC Men's U19 Asia Cup 2026 final is on Saturday, November 14, at the Al Amerat Cricket Ground (Ministry Turf 2) in Oman. The toss is at 10:00 a.m. IST and the first ball at 10:30 a.m. IST — 9:00 p.m. PT on Friday and 12:00 a.m. ET on Saturday for North American viewers.
  • Pakistan are the defending champions and the tournament's only unbeaten team. They beat India by three wickets in the group stage, chasing 209 after recovering from 61 for 5, with Hamza Zahoor scoring an unbeaten century.
  • India reached the final with an eight-wicket win over Afghanistan in the semi-final, captain Lakshya Raichandani scoring 93. Aaryavir Sehwag is the tournament's leading run-scorer with 303 runs in four matches.
  • Watch in India on the Sony Sports Network (Ten 1 English, Ten 3 Hindi, Ten 4 Tamil and Telugu) or stream on SonyLIV. Viewers outside India should check local broadcasters, as rights differ by country.

India and Pakistan meet again with a trophy on the line. The final of the ACC Men's U19 Asia Cup 2026 will be played on Saturday, November 14, at the Al Amerat Cricket Ground (Ministry Turf 2) in Oman, with the toss at 10:00 a.m. IST and play starting at 10:30 a.m. IST. India, led by Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani, are chasing a record-extending ninth title. Pakistan, captained by Farhan Yousaf, arrive as defending champions and the only unbeaten side in the tournament.

How the two sides got here

The finalists have already met once in this tournament, in the group stage on November 8 at the same venue. India posted 208, and Pakistan's chase lurched to 61 for 5 before wicketkeeper-batter Hamza Zahoor's unbeaten century carried them to 209 for 7 in 48.1 overs and a three-wicket win, according to SportsLine's tournament recap.

India recovered from that defeat, beat the UAE, and then produced their most complete performance in the second semi-final, defeating Afghanistan by eight wickets. Afghanistan were held to 227 for 8, and India chased the target in 36.5 overs, with Raichandani scoring 93, Aaryavir Sehwag 51 and V.K. Vineeth an unbeaten 57.

Pakistan's route was smoother. They have not lost a match, and they beat Bangladesh by nine wickets in the first semi-final to set up a second straight India-Pakistan final.

The players who could decide it

For India, the numbers start with Aaryavir Sehwag, son of former India opener Virender Sehwag. He is the tournament's leading run-scorer with 303 runs from four matches at an average of 101, with one century and two fifties. With the ball, fast bowler Ishan Sood has taken 11 wickets in four games.

Pakistan's form players mirror India's. Usman Khan is their top run-getter with 238 runs, seamer Rizwanullah has 11 wickets — the same tally as Sood — and Zahoor has already shown, in the group game, that he can finish a chase under pressure against this attack.

A final with recent history

The two sides also met in the final of the previous edition, in Dubai, which Pakistan won by 191 runs. India have spoken of settling that score, and a win on Saturday would stretch their lead as the most successful team in the competition's history. For Pakistan, a second straight title would confirm that the group-stage result was no fluke.

How to watch

In India, the final is live on the Sony Sports Network — Sony Sports Ten 1 for English coverage, Ten 3 for Hindi and Ten 4 for Tamil and Telugu commentary — and streaming on the SonyLIV app and website, where an eligible subscription may be required. The 10:30 a.m. IST start translates to 9:00 a.m. local time in Oman, 9:00 p.m. PT on Friday night and midnight ET in North America. Viewers outside India should check their local broadcasters and streaming services, as rights and availability differ by country. The playing XIs will be confirmed at the toss.
